name: Dot blooms into the next scene
visual_intent: A full stop or accent dot expands to fill the frame and becomes the next scene's background colour.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Element whose position and colour seed the bloom

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Seconds from source size to full cover

parameters.name: ease
parameters.description: Growth ease; accelerating reads as a burst

parameters.name: ring
parameters.description: Optional colour of a ring that leads the fill

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: become (colour becomes background) or reveal (new scene inside the circle)

timeline_requirements.gsap_instance: Timeline passed to Studio.build(builder) (registered as window.__timelines['root'])
timeline_requirements.timing_anchors: Cue map (Studio.cues) or beat grid (Studio.rhythm.grid); place the bloom on the beat that ends the scene

code_snippet.javascript:
// give #s2 the same background as the dot so the cut is invisible
Studio.fx.bloom(tl, '#s1 .st-wb-dot', '#s1', '#s2', cue('next'), { duration: 0.7, ring: Studio.token('--c-paper') });

fallbacks: Studio.fx.iris (clip-path circle at a percentage centre) or the approved zero-dip crossfade if the source is not visible at the cue.

performance_characteristics.memory_impact: Low; estimate, not measured on the M2

validation_steps: python scripts/frame-review.py tests/reference-derived/pen-and-bloom/index.html --fonts google --at <bloom start, middle, end>
npx hyperframes check on the render host; then hyperframes snapshot at the bloom start, middle and cut

validation.evidence: Runtime self-test tests/studio-runtime/reference-techniques.html in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-10-30.
